confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rely on aggregator and crowd-sourced prices that conflict with each other, and some are dated. Beer, cocktail and wine are inferred from Melbourne and Sydney pub and bar data with a downward adjustment for Newcastle. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; no live listings were checked. The FX value (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from search-result summaries that cite RBA data. I did not open the RBA page directly, and I found no 2026-11-19 fixing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Drink and restaurant anchors are benchmarked against aggregated Sydney and Melbourne price data, lowered slightly because one cost-of-living aggregator puts Newcastle restaurant prices modestly below Sydney's. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized regional Australian coastal city, not a Sydney-level market.
